answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable deposit and earn standing through a chain of verified completed tasks, each receipt counterparty-signed. One operator can spin up an ocean of clones, but each clone must separately fund its deposit and rebuild history from zero, so attacker cost scales with every fake identity while honest agents keep one record. Random audits prune any meadow of fresh accounts showing no real work, and a failed audit burns the deposit. Like a slow-growing juniper, reputation becomes a function of time and money spent, not of how many identities one operator can mint.
